title: Caroline review digest (Phase-2 grader output)
description: The structured digest the Phase-2 grader writes to ${WORKDIR}/digest.json. Enforced mechanically by scripts/validate-digest.sh (which also RECOMPUTES every unique_customers via cluster-questions.sh and drops sub-threshold themes). Rendered deterministically by scripts/render-digest.py - the grader NEVER writes header lines, Slack links, or Block Kit JSON.

severity.description: Drives the status emoji and the P0 ping - computed by the renderer, never hand-written.

tools.description: MUST be "skipped" iff preflight exported CV_TOOL_CTX_CONVERSATION_ID=unavailable (validate-digest.sh enforces both directions).

missed_shipped.description: Source 2 (shipped-leaks.jsonl). Never conflate with source 1; each hit is a P0.

source.description: CAROLINE_REASONING_LEAK_SOURCE from preflight. Non-journalctl renders a degraded caveat.

conversation_id.description: May come from audit.jsonl (escalated convs are absent from the fetch by design) - the ONLY place audit-sourced ids are legal.

note.description: e.g. signature "ready-to-output" or the escalation reason.

text.description: One terse clause, ~12 words max, plain prose. NO conversation ids in prose (the renderer strips them; evidence renders from conversation_ids as numbered links). P0/P1 text renders as a standalone action bullet at the top of the post - write it as an actionable clause. No URLs, no Slack mrkdwn links, no em-dashes.

conversation_ids.description: Every id MUST exist in conversations.jsonl - hallucinated evidence fails validation.

findings.description: Detail bullets. Emit only real, non-zero findings (collapse-clean is preserved: a clean dimension has no entries). good_catch entries use severity "info".

label.description: Short noun phrase, e.g. "Spotify-for-Artists sync stuck".

summary.description: One terse clause, ~12 words max, of what customers are saying. NO conversation ids in prose.

unique_customers.description: Advisory only - validate-digest.sh RECOMPUTES it by contact_id dedupe and overwrites; themes with a recomputed count < 2 are dropped (informational threshold).

themes.description: Cross-conversation recurrence: multiple customers saying the same thing. Cluster semantically over conversations.redacted.jsonl.

proposed_kb_note.description: The KB edit text a human would paste - text only, no target path in v1 (auto-PR stays manual via open-kb-pr.sh).

kb_gap_candidates.description: WEEKLY ONLY (validation fails a daily digest carrying any). Each needs a RECOMPUTED unique_customers >= 3 or the run fails.

degraded.description: Source caveats to surface verbatim in the context footer, e.g. "conv fetch hit the 200 cap - window under-sampled".
